comment: If you really want to learn Arabic and understand the region, take this amazing, caring, and smart professor.

One of the best professors I have ever had is super kind, funny, and cares so much about his students. Beyond that, he is an amazing and extremely smart teacher who will help you learn about such interesting things by making it fun and enjoyable. 100% take him if you can.
Honestly the best professor I have ever had, cares to see people succeed and is super helpful whenever you have questions. You need to participate in class discussions to get an A.
Dr. Gasimov is the best professor I have ever had. He is extremely kind, and dedicated so much time and energy to helping his students. I can't recommend him enough.

Dr. Gasimov is the kindest professor I've ever had.  He cares deeply about the material and wants to hear all his students opinions.  He is very understanding with deadlines and isn't a harsh grader.  I recommend taking class with him as you will learn a lot.  He opens class every week by asking students how their lives are, and actually listens.
He is an excellent teacher. This class was two and a half hours with a break in the middle once a week. He made that time go by pretty quickly and was super chill. Very knowledgeable.
